construction: The q96 F8 hyperoval map with mode 11 (height 23) removed from both the embedding and retraction supports. All remaining coordinates are retained; the ten canonical height-25 boundary triples remain because they do not use mode 11.
scope: Complete finite natural profile of the q94 map obtained by dropping mode 11 from q96. The pressure is numerical, not an exact certificate. It is above q96, q99, and 1/sqrt(2); the cutoff-47 pilot was unresolved and did not survive the complete profile. The map removes part of the full height-below-24 core, so the height-38 floor theorem does not apply. The complete factoring exponent is unchanged.
